introHtml: New Era is known for its iconic headwear, but their t shirts bring the same quality and fit. The Heritage Blend Crew Tee offers a classic look with a soft cotton-poly blend that holds up to frequent washing. For marketing directors or safety managers, these shirts provide a consistent, professional appearance across your crew. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for durable branding that lasts.
